title: 门槛 · 彩铅与软石墨试稿
status: 入口画风候选，待用户评审
prompt:
Completely REDRAW the attached scene as a finely drawn colored-pencil and soft graphite illustration on pale warm-gray laid paper. Use the attachment as a blocking diagram only: left traveler, a walkable labyrinth entrance just off center, and a seated human gatekeeper with his three-card stall on the right. The visual technique of the attachment was rejected. Produce one new full-bleed horizontal 16:10 image, whole scene in a single frame.

The artist worked from the light of the paper, building volume up through many small, light, pressure-sensitive curved pencil strokes and gentle graphite rubbing. Make this obvious at first glance. Draw with powder-blue, warm gray, dusty umber, muted lilac and a little amber pencil, with bits of exposed cream paper sparkling between marks. Fine arcs change direction as they go around a cheek or a knuckle. Fabrics are softly rounded by accumulated strokes curving around tension points, rather than angular patches of dark paint. The stone reveals its dimensions by subtle striations, chalk catching on a ledge, and long continuous shifts through multiple intermediate values. Keep transitions handsomely drawn, flowing and legible, not smudged all over. Contours appear and disappear in the ambient light; the hand holding the card has a few very fine local accents. This is an intimate, imaginative book illustration with slightly elongated expressive adult proportions and economical faces, unmistakably a drawing: no photorealism, 3D render, ink lines, comic hatching, posterized flat color areas, gouache cutouts, hard-edged polygon facets, continuous contour outlines or blocky sculpted faces. Keep material detail concentrated around the action. Show differences in texture through the direction of marks, not random detail sprinkled everywhere. Leave open light air between people, deep velvety graduated shadow in the corridor, and a modest readable range from light to dark.

Outside on a scorched plain, the hungry traveler's shoulders have fallen. In a three-quarter stance, facing the stall, the traveler tips a collapsed little provision pouch so its opening is clearly downward; a few grains of ash are all that fall. One foot hesitates on the worn step. Beyond, two colossal off-register walls rise out of frame, their slightly eroded stone edges catching pale reflected light; the passage makes one bend into dusty blue-violet shade. It reads as a physically passable maze, whose depths remain hidden. Near that opening the gatekeeper sits low behind a simple knee-high wooden table. A quiet tired middle-aged face in a naturally hanging sleeve; one bare dusty hand tenderly straightens a single cream paper card with two fingertips on a small clean cloth; two more cards beside it, each bearing a tiny faded, hand-drawn doorway motif. A small shaded lamp beside the stall lends warm light to the knuckles, cards and cloth. Both people and the cards must be easy to see, grounded on the same slope. No text, UI, captions, border, signature, weapon or crowds. The storytelling lives in these two small gestures.
